picks.title: Anthropic's new hardware standard lets AI agents control the physical world
picks.excerpt: Standardized driver interface aims to let devices talk to AI and each other.
picks.rationale: AI 에이전트가 실제 기기를 조작하는 표준 드라이버 규격 — 하드웨어 인터랙션 설계에 새 레이어가 생기는 이번 주 최대 뉴스.

picks.title: Lawsuit says Oura sleep tracking has 'a coin flip's chance of being correct'
picks.excerpt: The class action lawsuit claims that Oura's sleep-tracking mechanisms sell 'faulty AI-based inference as reliable science.'
picks.rationale: AI 추론 점수를 '과학'처럼 보여주는 UI가 법정에 섰다 — 웨어러블 지표를 설계하는 사람에게 바로 걸리는 책임 문제.

picks.title: Apple Caught Off Guard by AI Demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
picks.excerpt: Apple's unusually timed announcement of new Mac mini and Mac Studio models this week was driven by unexpectedly strong enterprise appetite for AI hardware, according to The Information. Apple normally releases new Mac models in the autumn, closer to October or November, making this week's announcement unusually early, falling just before the anticipated arrival of new iPhone models. The Information says that the AI-driven boom in Mac Studio and Mac mini sales is behind the early launch.
picks.rationale: 로컬 AI 수요가 출시 일정까지 당겼다 — 크리에이터 워크스테이션을 언제 무엇으로 살지에 직결되는 신호.

picks.title: China's robots race ahead
picks.excerpt: Bots were breaking records and breaking down at Beijing's World Humanoid Robot Games.
picks.rationale: 베이징 휴머노이드 로봇 경기 현장 르포 — 데모 영상이 아니라 실제로 무엇이 되고 무엇이 부서지는지 보여준다.

picks.title: Stop Touching Your Keyboard. Use This AI-Powered Microphone Instead
picks.excerpt: The Relay Q, due next year, is the latest attempt to reposition voice as the most seamless method for human-computer interaction.
picks.rationale: 키보드 대신 음성을 1차 입력으로 되돌리려는 전용 하드웨어 — 입력 방식 자체를 다시 묻는 폼팩터.
